text: Our team decided to use a local LLM and focus on retrieval quality and conflict handling. We want the system to find the most relevant clauses, show supporting evidence, and highlight conflicting rules. When the evidence is unclear, it should ask for human review.

textPreview: Improvements |  | Better query matching | Updated hybrid scoring | Checks for conflicting conditions

text: I tested two new documents: a derived governance dataset and a synthetic conflict dataset. I kept reference answers out of the search index. I improved query matching and hybrid scoring, and added checks for eligibility requirements, approval conditions, and policy exceptions. This experiment used local LSA and rule-based responses, not LLM-generated answers.

text: For paraphrased questions, the system found the expected evidence in 13 out of 15 cases, compared with 9 before. It reported the correct conflict pair in 16 out of 20 cases, compared with 14 before. All 75 regression tests passed. These are development results on synthetic data. Next, I will investigate the missed cases and test with unseen questions. Source: experiment_outputs/text_only_20260909/REPORT_KO.md and before/after benchmark JSON files.
